title: Subscription contract
description: Schema for landingzones/<archetype>/<sub-name>.yaml. Validated by .github/workflows/pr-validate.yml on every PR.

archetype.description: Landing-zone archetype. Must match a folder under landingzones/ and an archetype supported by the selected starter.

displayName.description: Azure subscription display name. Defaults to filename without .yaml.

aliasName.description: EA / MCA subscription alias. Defaults to filename without .yaml. Must be unique within the billing scope.

workload.description: Lifecycle classifier — emitted as the `environment` tag. Defaults to Production. Set to DevTest to opt in to Dev/Test pricing (requires EA/MCA entitlement; see docs/onboarding.md).

location.description: Default Azure region for resources created by this module (network RG, etc). No default — must be set.

owner.description: Business owner email or distribution list. Emitted as the `businessowner` tag and used for budget alerts.

technicalResponsible.description: Technical owner email. Emitted as `technicalcontact` tag. Defaults to `owner` if omitted.

costCenter.description: Finance cost-center code (string — leading zeros matter). Emitted as `costcenter` tag.

workloadName.description: Human-friendly workload name. Emitted as `workloadname` tag. Defaults to aliasName if omitted.

costAllocationCode.description: Optional user-defined cost-allocation code (e.g. project / activity / WBS code). Emitted as the tag key configured by the operator, which defaults to projectcode. Required when platform policy enables it. Pattern enforcement is applied during deployment preview.

billingScopeKey.description: Selects which billing scope from `billing_scopes` is used when creating this subscription. Defaults to `default`. See docs/billing-scopes.md.

tags.description: Free-form tag map merged on top of mandatory + archetype + identity tags. Caller wins on conflict.

network.description: Spoke networking. Set enabled:false to skip VNet/peering entirely.

budget.description: Subscription-scoped consumption budget. REQUIRED for sandbox.

roleAssignments.description: Subscription-scoped role assignments. Keys are arbitrary and values are normalized for the selected AVM engine.

managedIdentity.description: Optional user-assigned managed identity provisioned alongside the subscription.

then.description: Sandbox subscriptions MUST declare a budget.
